digest.component_or_area: Plan structure validation and P1 readiness enforcement
propositions: Empty joined bodies in Acceptance Criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity and block P1 readiness.
Unresolved sentinel assignments (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail deterministic clarity unless suppressed by same-line negation or removal terms.
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must not trigger sentinel detection.
Sentinel matches require specific syntactic positions: line start, bullet start, after colon/equals, or after is/remains/left, with case-insensitive matching.
Same-line presence of no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, or without suppresses sentinel match on that line.
Shared parser implementation must preserve existing clarity score compatibility and ticket-type exemptions while enforcing new structural floors.
